單眼影像可以透過失焦程度推算距離，但焦平面兩側可能出現相同的模糊量；場景背景也會: Defocus can indicate distance, but equal blur may occur on both sides of the focal plane. Backgrounds contaminate vehicle edges, while grayscale conversion can weaken color boundaries with similar luminance. Building on DFDS segmentation and spatial-domain ranging, CA-DFDS estimates meter-scale distance from one defocused image with fixed camera settings.
將焦平面設於 15 m，置於 1–7 m 測距區間之外，使理論散焦量在區間內單調: Focus is set to 15 m, beyond the 1–7 m measurement range, making theoretical blur monotonic within the range. Each estimate uses one f/1.4 image.
以 CIECAM02 取得明度 J 與色彩分量 a: CIECAM02 provides lightness J and chroma components a
，再從車輛遮罩內的拉普拉斯反應萃取清晰度。: ; sharpness is extracted from Laplacian responses inside the vehicle mask.
在已知距離的白、灰、黑車影像上交替更新通道權重和二次距離曲線，把清晰度映射成公尺: Channel weights and a quadratic distance curve are updated alternately on white, gray and black vehicles at known distances to map sharpness to meters.
線上測距依序經過成像、分割、色彩轉換、清晰度量測與距離映射。離線校正提供測距時使: Inference consists of imaging, segmentation, color conversion, sharpness measurement and distance mapping. Offline calibration supplies the channel weights and quadratic curve.
沿用作品說明書圖 1。圖中清晰度框採式 (7) 表記。本頁 CARLA 評測採式: From Figure 1 of the submitted report. The diagram uses Eq. (7) notation; this page's CARLA evaluation uses Eq. (5): combine weighted Laplacian responses before measuring the masked standard deviation.
薄透鏡模型以模糊圈直徑描述失焦程度。對焦 15 m 時，車輛都位於焦平面同一側。: The thin-lens model describes defocus through blur-circle diameter. At a 15 m focus distance, vehicles lie on one side of the focal plane. f/1.4 produces larger blur circles and stronger distance sensitivity than f/22.
說明書採用 SAM 2 或人工遮罩。後續本機全自動流程由 YOLO11m 提供車: The report uses SAM 2 or annotated masks. The subsequent local automatic pipeline uses YOLO11m boxes and SAM ViT-B pixel masks. Distance is estimated from optical features and the calibration curve.
採式 (5) 將 J、a: Eq. (5) combines Laplacian responses of J, a
的拉普拉斯反應加權合成，在遮罩內取標準差 σ。交替固定權重擬合二次曲線、固定曲線: using channel weights, then measures masked standard deviation σ. Quadratic fitting with fixed weights alternates with weight updates using a fixed curve. The report uses SLSQP; inference applies the fitted parameters directly.

評測設定、方法與自動分割: Evaluation settings, baselines and automatic masks
CARLA Town05 消防車實驗使用 40 mm 鏡頭與 15 m 對焦。白: CARLA Town05 firetruck experiments use a 40 mm lens focused at 15 m. White, gray and black calibration samples span 1.0–7.0 m. Offset test distances span 1.2–6.7 m, with 120 images each for red, green, blue and black. Black is also a calibration color. The 19-color and physical tabletop studies use separate protocols.
上列為 480 張影像的整體 RMSE。CA-DFDS 與線性校正後的 UniD: Overall RMSE is measured on 480 images. CA-DFDS and linearly calibrated UniDepth V2 perform similarly overall: 0.225 vs. 0.467 m at 1.2–3.7 m, and 0.421 vs. 0.191 m at 4.2–6.7 m. The J-only ablation achieves 0.313 m, indicating sensitivity to chroma weights and calibration data.

單張 RGB 的學習式公制深度模型。以車輛遮罩內的深度中位數做距離，另以 CAR: Learned metric depth from one RGB image. Median depth within the vehicle mask is used for distance, with linear recalibration on the CARLA calibration set.
